calls.title: AirOps Quick Sync
calls.summary: The meeting addressed ongoing SEO issues, particularly slow Google indexing of new Insights articles despite manual submissions, with factors like site health and internal linking raised. Non-branded organic traffic has increased to 9%, showcasing better reach, though distinguishing human from bot traffic remains a challenge. Gaps in analytics due to the absence of Google Tag Manager on key pages hinder conversion tracking, while current dashboards lack flexibility. The team aims to keep Insights content high-quality by planning updates and enhancing cross-linking with the blog for better visibility. Additionally, team member Karen Henke announced her transition to part-time special projects, signifying a shift in operational focus and content management practices.
calls.keywords: Google Indexing, Internal Linking, Conversion Tracking, HubSpot Forms, Organic Traffic, Content Optimization
calls.action_items:
**Jack Virag**
Add internal links from blog posts to Insights articles to improve indexing signals and coordinate with Growth Book team to decide on appropriate internal linking strategy without over-saturating site navigation (20:15)
Investigate crawl speed issues and site health factors affecting Google’s indexing frequency for the Growth Book website (25:20)
Plan and execute a “deletion session” to remove low-value content based on Looker Studio data to optimize site quality and performance (27:55)

**Jason Faber**
Share Looker Studio reports and grant proper access to team members to enable effective monitoring and analysis of organic traffic and content performance (05:00)
Continue monitoring Google Search Console and inspect URLs to understand indexing delays or issues, especially related to sitemaps and crawl notifications (23:30)
Push for updating high-value blog posts identified, such as “best AB testing platforms,” to maintain content relevance and performance and avoid dated URLs for easier future updates (17:00)

**Karen Henke**
Transition to part-time role focusing on special projects primarily around content and project management, effective around June 5th, while supporting Looker Studio reporting and tracking setup improvements (28:30)
Collaborate with engineering and Growth Book team to advocate for improved Google Tag Manager deployment on auth, sign-in, and demo pages to enable conversion tracking (08:20)

**Unassigned**
Address HubSpot iframe limitations on demo request forms, potentially seeking workaround for conversion tracking since direct redirect or thank you-page triggers are blocked (10:10)
